1.6.0.title: Cards and Apple Watch
features: Cards Mode: Swipe through cue cards, one thought each, with a timer.
Cards on Lock Screen: See your cards with the timer and turn them from the Lock Screen.
Apple Watch: Run the teleprompter, turn cards, or keep decks on your wrist.
Action Button: Play or pause the teleprompter without touching the screen.
Help: Tap ? on any screen for tips.
